Contact and Support

Contact BeMama for support, privacy requests, deletion/export requests, and safety review.

Support

Email support@bemamas.com for product support, account help, deletion/export requests, privacy questions, or review of AI-assisted content.

Privacy requests

For deletion, export, correction, or privacy review, include the email or account identifier associated with your BeMama account. Do not send urgent medical information by email.

Urgent care

BeMama support is not emergency support. For urgent symptoms, medical concerns, self-harm concerns, or immediate safety issues, contact qualified local care or emergency services.

BeMama

General education and support only. Not a medical diagnosis tool.
